title: Cute design, but many flaws
text: Cute design, but many flaws. This design is adorable. The material of the tree skirt feels sturdy. The hot glue gun job is terrible. There are many spots of hot glue just randomly dried into the skirt. The snowflakes and the little faces are not glued on well. They are loose and falling off. It came folded in a way that makes the faces very wrinkly. I do not think I can do much about the wrinkles since the decorations are so half-hazardly glued on they will not be able to handle the dryer, steam, or an iron.
